answer: Time-locked vesting blunts sybils: each identity's rewards grow like a vine over 60 days, released in small weekly tranches only while that identity keeps passing fresh, jury-graded challenges. An attacker spinning up 500 accounts must sustain 500 streams of real work for two months before any coin is spendable; a zephyr-quick swarm of fakes earns nothing liquid. Slashing for copied answers claws back the unvested balance, so the attacker climbs a long ridge of cost before any payoff.
